criteria.conditional_scope: Every attempted generating contour J, including J=0; exact truth tolerances copied from Stage 9C.
criteria.failure_mapping: Source/cache/implementation integrity -> FAILED-CONDITIONAL with explicit reason; quotas/ESS -> FAILED-VISITATION; lost mode or disconnected return graph -> FAILED-MIXING; remaining conditional truth -> FAILED-CONDITIONAL; compression truth -> FAILED-COMPRESSION; restart -> FAILED-RESTART.
criteria.freeze_final_top: Final ell_6 is newly accepted, not the generating contour of construction history. Its mass is checked analytically; no extra chain is authorized there.
criteria.immediate_failure: Audit selection before calibration, then calibration before next attempt. Fail at first failed requirement. No tuning, new method, seed, budget or retry.
criteria.mixing_scope: Each bank at every disconnected generating contour: >=5 saved physical level-0 cross-mode returns, >=10 retained top-mode changes, and strongly connected directed return graph over all 3 modes.
criteria.pass_logic: All six candidates accepted; every bank passes conditional/mode/mixing/ESS/compression/visit checks; protected hashes unchanged; no reconstruction samples exported; one fresh-process restart exactly matches.

design.exchange_rule: disabled identity for all pairs and both arms; no cross-bank interactions
design.inherited_settings: Budgets, quotas, parameter settings, numeric tolerances and ESS copied unchanged from Stage 9C; new model was not used to choose them.

level_weights.rule: Use prefix zeros; log a_j = -log Xhat_j. Weights frozen before each attempt; no adaptation.

model.mode_definition: geometric nearest-center regions, fixed before sampling
model.novelty: Three asymmetric modes with unequal widths and weights; not Stage 9A, Stage 9C or Stage 8H.

posterior_truth.note: Independent exact Gaussian integrals; not a reconstruction trajectory or estimator.

design.reconstruction_policy: No imports, invocation or export of reconstruction records; only analytic model truth is integrated.

restart.provenance: Parent Popen receipt, PID/PPID, independent startup UUIDs, UTC timestamps, full launch command.
restart.required: Exactly one new child process continues from completed level 3 and selection midpoint; no retry.

design.thinning: none: retain first 2048 post-burn assigned-top observations per walker, including self-loops

failure_summary.note: Frozen retained top-level samples failed exact-truth tolerances despite high compression ESS and a connected return graph. No theoretical change to the joint target is inferred.
